# GENERATED by scripts/kehillah_library_condition.py from
# scripts/kehillah_library_catalog.json -- edit the catalog or the script, not this file.
# The Repair button on a book's page. The shelf's library goes along as
# scope:library; only its holder may pay to mend its books.

kehillah_lib_repair_work_targum_onkelos = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { library }
	is_shown = {
		scope:library ?= {
			holder ?= root
			OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_worn target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_fragile target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
			}
		}
	}
	is_valid = {
		kehillah_lib_can_afford_repair_trigger = { WORK = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
	}
	effect = {
		scope:library = { kehillah_lib_pay_and_repair_effect = { WORK = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
	}
}

	saved_scopes = { library }
	is_shown = {
		scope:library ?= {
			holder ?= root
			OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_worn target = flag:work_authored_89 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_fragile target = flag:work_authored_89 }
			}
		}
	}
	is_valid = {
		kehillah_lib_can_afford_repair_trigger = { WORK = flag:work_authored_89 }
	}
	effect = {
		scope:library = { kehillah_lib_pay_and_repair_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_89 } }
	}
}
